tasks.objective: Implement retry with exponential backoff in app/notify.py (3 attempts, 1s/2s/4s delays, retry on all non-2xx including 429) and add unit tests in tests/test_notify.py covering: success-after-retry, all-attempts-fail (single persisted record), 429-retryable, and first-attempt-success (attempts=1).

concepts: retry semantics: retry on non-2xx, persist once after final outcome
429 as transient error (staging capture: first 429, second 202)

forbidden_scope: app/provider.py (read-only context; the client interface is frozen)
app/db.py (read-only context; the store interface is frozen)
app/api.py (the handler just calls send_notification; no change needed)
tests/test_gateway_observed.py (read-only reference for 429 behavior; do not modify)
inputs: stage-contract.json (C1 retry policy, C2 return shape, C3 client interface)
tasks.split_rationale: Single context closure: the retry implementation (app/notify.py) and its tests (tests/test_notify.py) share the same 5 files, same 3 contracts (C1/C2/C3), and the same retry-state-model concepts. Splitting would force two agents to re-read provider.py and db.py for no context savings. The 2 layers (service + e2e) are below the 3-layer split threshold.
